    JWT¶

    Authentication¶

    rn_forge.django.auth.jwt.authentication ¶

    JWT authentication classes for rn-forge auth.

    JWTAuthentication ¶

    SimpleJWT authentication that wraps validated tokens as rn-forge credentials. This should be registered in the DRF settings['DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES].

    authenticate(request) ¶

    Return the authenticated user plus :class:JWTCredentials.

    Credentials¶

    rn_forge.django.auth.jwt.credentials ¶

    JWT-backed credentials for rn-forge auth.

    JWTCredentials(user, auth) ¶

    Bases: BaseCredentials

    Credentials wrapper backed by a validated JWT token.

    email property ¶

    Return email from token claims or fallback to wrapped user.

    is_authenticated property ¶

    Return whether the wrapped user is authenticated.

    is_staff_user property ¶

    Return whether the wrapped user should bypass permission checks.

    payload property ¶

    Return the validated token payload.

    permissions property ¶

    Return JWT permission keys when present.

    profile property ¶

    Return the JWT profile payload when present.

    user_id property ¶

    Return user id from token claims or fallback to wrapped user.

    get_claim(key, default=None) ¶

    Return one token claim.

    has_any_permission(permissions) ¶

    Return whether JWT-backed permissions grant any in permissions.

    has_permission(permission) ¶

    Return whether JWT-backed permissions grant permission.

    Mixins¶

    rn_forge.django.auth.jwt.mixins ¶

    SimpleJWT mixins layered on top of rn-forge-django DRF auth helpers.

    JWTAuthenticationViewMixin ¶

    Bases: BaseLoginViewMixin[_UserT]

    Authentication mixin that returns SimpleJWT access/refresh tokens.

    build_jwt_claims(login_payload) ¶

    Return flat JWT claims to apply to the refresh/access token pair.

    build_login_payload(request) ¶

    Return the normalized login payload for this login request.

    build_login_response(login_payload) ¶

    Return the default JWT-based login payload for user.

    complete_login(request, login_payload) ¶

    Persist the Django session and return the final login response.

    get_user_permissions(login_payload) ¶

    Return effective permission keys from the wrapped user when available.

    get_user_roles(login_payload) ¶

    Return role names from the wrapped user when available.

    login(request) ¶

    Authenticate a user into the Django session and return an HTTP response.

    logout(request) staticmethod ¶

    Log out the current session user.

    LoginExchangeViewMixin ¶

    Bases: BaseLoginViewMixin[_UserT]

    Login view mixin that returns a short-lived exchange JWT.

    build_login_exchange_token(login_payload) ¶

    Return the short-lived exchange token for the login handoff.

    build_login_payload(request) ¶

    Return the normalized login payload for this login request.

    build_login_response(login_payload) ¶

    Return the default login-exchange payload for user.

    complete_login(request, login_payload) ¶

    Return the exchange token without creating a Django session.

    login(request) ¶

    Authenticate a user into the Django session and return an HTTP response.

    logout(request) staticmethod ¶

    Log out the current session user.

    Utils¶

    rn_forge.django.auth.jwt.utils ¶

    SimpleJWT helpers for rn-forge-django.

    JWTUtils ¶

    Static helpers for minting and inspecting SimpleJWT tokens.

    add_claims(token, **claims) staticmethod ¶

    Add custom claims to a mutable SimpleJWT token and return it.

    build_login_exchange_token(user, *, token_type='login_exchange', lifetime=timedelta(minutes=5)) staticmethod ¶

    Return a short-lived JWT for the login-exchange handoff.

    build_token_pair(user) staticmethod ¶

    Return refresh and access token strings for user.

    build_token_pair_with_claims(user, **claims) staticmethod ¶

    Return refresh/access tokens after applying custom claims.

    create_access_token(user) staticmethod ¶

    Create and return an access token string for user.

    create_refresh_token(user) staticmethod ¶

    Create and return a refresh token for user.

    validate_login_exchange_token(token) staticmethod ¶

    Return a decoded login-exchange token payload.

    Views¶

    rn_forge.django.auth.jwt.views ¶

    JWT token-exchange views for rn-forge auth.

    UserTokenView ¶

    Bases: JWTAuthenticationViewMixin[_UserT], BaseLoginAPIView

    Exchange a short-lived login token for the final JWT pair.

    drf_request property ¶

    Return self.request narrowed to a DRF request.

    build_jwt_claims(login_payload) ¶

    Return flat JWT claims to apply to the refresh/access token pair.

    build_login_payload(request) ¶

    Build the final JWT payload from the exchange token.

    build_login_response(login_payload) ¶

    Return the default JWT-based login payload for user.

    complete_login(request, login_payload) ¶

    Return the final JWT payload without creating a Django session.

    get_exchange_token(request) ¶

    Return the incoming login-exchange token.

    get_exchange_token_payload(request) ¶

    Return the decoded login-exchange payload.

    get_login_exchange_user(exchange_payload) ¶

    Resolve the target user from the exchange token payload.

    get_request_auth() ¶

    Return the current request auth payload.

    get_request_data(key=None, default=None) ¶

    Return request data, or one body value when key is provided.

    get_request_param(key, default=None) ¶

    Return a query parameter or default_value.

    get_request_string(key, default=None) ¶

    Return a query/body value as a string.

    get_request_user() ¶

    Return the current authenticated request user.

    get_request_value(key, default=None) ¶

    Return a request-body value or default_value.

    get_user_permissions(login_payload) ¶

    Return effective permission keys from the wrapped user when available.

    get_user_roles(login_payload) ¶

    Return role names from the wrapped user when available.

    login(request) ¶

    Authenticate a user into the Django session and return an HTTP response.

    logout(request) staticmethod ¶

    Log out the current session user.

    post(request, *args, **kwargs) ¶

    Dispatch POST requests to :meth:login.
